Notes
-----

.. container:: note-item

   :ref:`X_372 <X_372>` is the external center of similitude of the circumcircle and the 2nd Lemoine circle (cosine circle) (Peter J. C. Moses, 5/9/03). Also, :ref:`X_372 <X_372>` is the external center of similitude of the Gallatly circle (defined just before X_2007) and the 1st Lemoine circle (Peter J. C. Moses, 9/10/03).

.. container:: note-item

   Let :g:`A'B'C' << A' B' C' >>` be the Lucas(-1) central triangle. Let :g:`A″ <A″>` be the cevapoint of :g:`B' <B'>` and :g:`C' <C'>`, and define :g:`B″ <B″>` and :g:`C″ <C″>` cyclically. The lines :g:`AA″ <[ A A″ ]>`, :g:`BB″ <[ B B″ ]>`, :g:`CC″ <[ C C″ ]>` concur in :ref:`X_372 <X_372>`. (:person:`Randy Hutson <randy-hutson>`, July 23, 2015)
